rich_text.plain_text: 2. Run Contract and action-level auditability

text.content: Each run now requires Run ID, prompt version, scope, evidence standard, complexity class, budget, coverage obligations, and known tool limits. rich_text.plain_text: 3. Evidence integrity

text.content: Search snippets/previews/cached summaries are explicitly downgraded to lead/context unless the underlying source is unavailable. Material claims should rely on directly retrieved source content or structured first-party evidence whenever possible.

text.content: 4. Freshness semantics

rich_text.plain_text: 4. Freshness semantics

text.content: Freshness is separated from price-evidence strength. A directly observed price may be Freshness=Unknown without creating a semantic contradiction. Live transactional states can support Current when there is no material staleness signal; recent observation alone is not sufficient when archival/stale signals exist.

text.content: External Research Signals

rich_text.plain_text: External Research Signals

text.content: DeepSearchQA explicitly evaluates multi-step research on systematic collation, deduplication/entity resolution, and stopping criteria, and reports persistent weaknesses in balancing recall and precision. BrowseComp similarly emphasizes persistence, strategic browsing, and synthesis across many sites. Current provenance work on LLM agents emphasizes claim-level evidence tracing and execution provenance rather than final-answer accuracy alone. Entity-resolution literature warns that early blocking can lose true matches, making blocking recall a real error surface. These findings support the v4.1 repair directions above.

BrowseComp similarly emphasizes persistence, strategic browsing, and synthesis across many sites. Current provenance work on LLM agents emphasizes claim-level evidence tracing and execution provenance rather than final-answer accuracy alone. Entity-resolution literature warns that early blocking can lose true matches, making blocking recall a real error surface. These findings support the v4.1 repair directions above.
